name: Malibu-Newton Canyon
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A Malibu Coast sub-area lying entirely within Newton Canyon, a bowl-shaped mountain basin below Castro Peak in the Santa Monica Mountains.
